history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A medium shot portrait of Indonesian President Joko Widodo, casually dressed and posing for the camera. He is wearing a dark brown jacket over a black t-shirt with a graphic design that appears to be a band logo, featuring the words "PALU" and "DEATH" in bold, stylized lettering, along with intricate illustrations. His left hand is raised, forming a peace sign with his index and middle fingers, while his right hand is also raised, making a devil's horns gesture with his index and pinky fingers extended. He has a slight smile and is looking directly at the viewer. The background suggests an indoor setting, possibly a room with traditional Indonesian art or artifacts. To the left, a framed painting with vibrant colors and figures is visible. The floor has a checkered pattern in shades of grey and white. The lighting is soft and natural, casting subtle shadows and highlighting his features. The overall mood is informal and approachable, with a touch of rock and roll attitude. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones from his clothing and the background elements, contrasted by the bright colors of the painting.
